## Pull Request Description

**This project is an unofficial open-source reference implementation.**

### Scope
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / cleanup
- [ ] Test coverage
- [ ] CI / build change

### Verification
Before submitting, confirm:
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `python3 -m pytest tests/` passes (from `starknet/` directory)
- [ ] No new TypeScript/ESLint errors introduced
- [ ] New code is tested
- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior changed

### Breaking changes
- [ ] This PR introduces breaking changes (describe below)

### Security considerations
Does this PR:
- [ ] Expose new on-chain state transitions?
- [ ] Change signature verification logic?
- [ ] Modify RPC call behavior?
- [ ] Add new dependencies?

Describe any security implications:

### Related issues
Fixes #(issue number)
